Locale Emulator v2.5.0.1
Copyright xupefei and Locale Emulator contributors.

AfterShelf ships the original LEProc.exe, LoaderDll.dll and LocaleEmulator.dll
as a separate helper. The bundled LEConfig.xml is generated by AfterShelf.

Official release and source for the launcher:
https://github.com/xupefei/Locale-Emulator/releases/tag/v2.5.0.1
https://github.com/xupefei/Locale-Emulator/tree/v2.5.0.1

Source and build instructions for the core DLLs:
https://github.com/xupefei/Locale-Emulator-Core/tree/ae7160dc5deb97947396abcd784f9b98b6ee38b3
